title: Chapter 2: a joint dies mid-task
judge_reason: the cube rests in the target zone and the gripper has released it
agent_summary: I picked up the red cube at [0.50, 0.00] and placed it in the green zone; check_task confirms success, with the cube at [0.502, -0.250], 1.8 mm from the zone centre, and the gripper open. Joint 0 (joint1) froze at about +0.007 rad. It first showed as a small lag during the descent, then caused the transport move to stop 14.4 cm short of its target. Diagnose confirmed joint 0 as suspected frozen, so I retried the transport with joint 0 excluded and kept it excluded for every later move, and all of them reached within 0.1 mm. The grasp held throughout, and the front camera shows the cube centred in the zone with the gripper clear above it.
